requirements.description: 4-entry RAS call push and ret pop target selection, fetch-group-crossing 4B branch target calculation, and br0 > br1 > mp BHT write priority.

MRAC uncacheable 2-beat vs cacheable 8-beat AXI read burst, critical-word two-half assembly (ic_crit_wd_rdy), ICCM region out-of-range access fault, and single-bit ECC correction state machine (ECC_CORR).
Latch-free synthesis <= 27,850.0 um^2 and WNS/WHS >= 0.00 ns at 3.65 ns clock.
